Main_FillOnMaximise: When a window is maximised, restore the taskbar
Main_FillOnTaskSwitch: When alt+tab or win+tab is pressed, restore the taskbar

Main_ToBegin: To begin, select a taskbar segment below.
Help_SplitBody:
Split mode has a couple of limitations and requires a small amount of setup to get working properly.

Limitations:
1) Split mode doesn't resize itself automatically. This feature will be coming to RoundedTB Revived for Windows 10 in the future.
2) Toolbars are not compatible with split mode currently, and will need to be disabled apart from one (more on that in a moment).
3) Split mode only works when the taskbar is horizontal at the top or bottom of the screen.

Setup:
1) Right-click the taskbar and disable "Lock the taskbar".
2) Right-click it again and turn off any existing toolbars.
3) Right-click a third time, select Toolbars > Desktop.
4) Use the small || handle to resize the taskbar as you please.
Help_CompatBody:
TranslucentTB is a utility that allows you to customise the opacity, blur and colour of the taskbar seamlessly with significantly finer control than other tools. Enable this option to allow RoundedTB Revived and TranslucentTB to work together.

This is necessary due to a bug in Windows (it's not the fault of RoundedTB Revived or TranslucentTB), and you might encounter some minor flickering when the taskbar "updates" (changes size, roundness or position). This is usually pretty minimal and many people use RoundedTB Revived and TranslucentTB in tandem without complaint, but if it bothers you then I recommend sticking with either RoundedTB Revived or TranslucentTB until a better solution is available.

Regardless though, go show TranslucentTB some love! It's a great Windows 10 aesthetic taskbar mod. Plus, the dev is pretty awesome 💖
About_Thanks: Thanks for downloading RoundedTB Revived. Expand the following categories for more information.
About_WhatsNewBody:
R4 (RoundedTB Revived) focuses on Windows 11 compatibility and stability:
• Windows 11 22H2+ / 24H2: dynamic segments now read the real icon bounds via UI Automation - running apps are no longer clipped and the strip left of the Start button is hidden properly.
• AutoHide is now a built-in feature that only applies when enabled in settings (it no longer hides the taskbar on every launch).
• Settings are written atomically and survive crashes; pre-3.0 configs are migrated automatically.
• The background loop no longer dies silently and recovers after Explorer restarts.
• Localization: English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Tip: use the built-in AutoHide instead of Windows' own auto-hide.
About_BasicOptionsBody:
• Margin - makes the taskbar slimmer on all sides by this many logical pixels.
• Corner radius - controls the radius of the taskbar's rounded corners.
• Advanced - toggles a menu of advanced and experimental features.
• Apply - applies and saves any unset changes.
About_AdvancedOptionsBody:
• [...] Margins - individually sets the margin for each side of the taskbar.
• Dynamic mode (Windows 11) - Dynamically adjusts the size of the taskbar depending on how many apps are open.
• Split mode (Windows 10) - allows you to resize the taskbar. Like dynamic mode, but manually adjustable; some setup is required, enable for more info.
• Show system tray - Displays the system tray in dynamic/split mode. This option can be toggled at any time by pressing Win+F2.
• Show system tray on hover - Displays the system tray in dynamic/split mode when the mouse hovers over it. This overrides the above option.
• TranslucentTB compatibility - enables compatibility with TranslucentTB. For more info, enable this option.
• Fill taskbar when maximised - Fills the taskbar when a window is maximised on that taskbar's monitor.
• Fill taskbar on alt+tab (Windows 11) - Fills taskbars when alt+tab or the Task Switcher is invoked.
About_KnownIssuesBody:
• AutoHide: use the built-in AutoHide option; enabling Windows' own auto-hide at the same time can cause flicker. AutoHide is still under testing and is not guaranteed to work in every environment.
• Due to the current localization approach, some buttons and labels may render incompletely in certain languages or contexts.
• Dynamic mode: when a new app icon appears the taskbar may briefly clip it in half before self-correcting (cosmetic only; being fixed in the next release).
• Windows 11 26H1: works, but occasional crashes (possibly related to Explorer) have been seen and are under investigation.
• Dynamic mode and split mode only work correctly when the taskbar is at the top or bottom of the monitor.
• Split mode on Windows 10 is only supported on the primary monitor.
• Taskbar mods other than TranslucentTB are not yet officially supported.
• Supported: Windows 11 22H2+ (verified on 24H2), Windows 11 26H1 (occasional crashes, see above) and Windows 10 (split mode).
